findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: During today’s inspection, inspectors observed no one on site who holds a food manager certificate. The PIC was informed. Ensure that a CFPM is on site when food’s being served and prepared.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Dish machine was observed with no measurable sanitizer concentration after running three cycles. CORRECTED- Maintenance was on-site and able to reset the machine. Sanitizer was then observed at 200ppm Cl. Ensure test strips are used to monitor dish machine sanitizer. Discussed 3 compartment sink use in the absence of the dish machine.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a concentration of 50-200ppm. [P]

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: No thermometer was present in the chest cooler. CORRECTED- PIC added a thermometer to the cooler. Ensure all cold-holding units have ambient thermometers placed in the warmest part of the unit (toward the front).
findings.citation_text: 4-204.112(A) Temperature Measuring Devices. (A) In a mechanically refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, the sensor of a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure the air temperature or a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of a mechanically refrigerated unit and in the coolest part of a hot FOOD storage unit. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Peeling paint was observed on the wall behind the 3 compartment sink/dish machine. Repair the wall so the surface is smooth, easily cleanable, and nonabsorbent.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.comment: Employee foods were observed intermixed with foods for service in the vertical cooler and freezer. CORRECTED- PIC designated the bottom shelf of the vertical cooler for storage of employee foods. Ensure employee foods are stored away from foods for service.
findings.citation_text: 6-403.11(A) Designated Areas. (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use TOBACCO PRODUCTS shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination. [C]
